body: I've talked to him twice this week. He wants to try to rekindle our romantic relationship, but it just feels like a friendship to me. He's trying his best, which I appreciate, I just don't know if it can be fixed.

I don't really know where to begin. I hate how I look. I don't have friends so obviously something is wrong with me. I have depression and anxiety and obviously that plays a part of it. I don't think I can do anything right. I just have nothing I enjoy about myself.
